Change pushed for review: Gerrit 1418 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1418), commit a8b75576c9 on branch fix/8a5e-vacuous-ast-guards, worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-8a5e (kept — the fix is unlanded).

Local gates at the time of push: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (mypy, 434 files, no issues), and all six touched test files green (7/7, 7/7, 33/33, 8/8, 12/12, 10/10). Nine tests added, none removed — verified by a per-file test-def count and a byte-identical diff of the pre-existing tail I had briefly clobbered mid-edit and restored.

NOT closing: awaiting Verified +1 and merge, per the policy that a passing completion verifier is not a substitute for green CI. At the time of writing Gerrit 1418 is status=NEW with LLM-Review=0 and Verified=0 (CI still queued on a loaded host); the full-repo pytest run was also still executing locally after ~70 minutes of contention with other agents on this machine. Neither is a signal about this change — both are pending, not failing.
